FHIR-28255 later confirmed R5 already had Duration|string and kept the period name. FHIR-35961 explains an R4B compatibility branch revert but does not affect current HEAD.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to represent ProductShelfLife.period as a Duration|string choice and refreshed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its embedded data matches that ModelInfo content.
